yb9499971544.add: - **Charging:** a body becomes **negative by gaining electrons** (positive by losing them); protons never move in charging.

ydf2114710ec.add: - **Prokaryotic cells** (bacteria) have **no membrane-bound organelles** – no mitochondria, nucleus or ER – but do have a cell wall, plasma membrane and 70S ribosomes.

ydd93e51301c.add: - **Plant vs animal cell:** only plant cells have a **cellulose cell wall** (all plant cells), plastids/chloroplasts (green cells only) and a large central vacuole.

yda2c2ffea3e.add: - **Plasma membrane** = lipid bilayer + proteins, **no nucleic acid**; nucleolus (rRNA), ribosome (rRNA) and chloroplast (own DNA) contain nucleic acids.

y9c7eb2d409c.add: - **Semi-autonomous organelles:** **chloroplasts** and mitochondria have their own DNA and ribosomes and divide on their own – the 'cell within a cell'.

y538603aa898.add: - **Active transport** moves ions **against the concentration gradient** using **ATP** (from respiration); diffusion and osmosis are passive (no energy).

y79c47699272.add: - **Nucleolus** = site of **rRNA synthesis and ribosome formation** (inside the nucleus).

y8dc86ec987f.add: - **Redox:** **oxidation** = gain of O / **loss of H** / loss of electrons; **reduction** = loss of O / **gain of H** / gain of electrons.

ya0750a6cd9f.add: - **Loss of oxygen = reduction** (CuO + H2 → Cu + H2O: CuO is reduced); corrosion is slow oxidation of a metal.

y738ab8cc5c1.add: - **Electroplating:** object to be plated = **cathode**; plating metal (pure Ni, Cr, Ag) = **anode**; electrolyte = a salt of that metal (e.g. nickel sulphate).

y278ed7d3ba1.add: - **Hydrogen atom:** ground-state energy **−13.6 eV**, so its **ionisation energy = 13.6 eV**.

y745a8198bc9.add: - **Conservation of mass-energy:** mass-energy can neither be created nor destroyed – 'something from nothing' is impossible (E = mc²).

ydc9ee6965d2.add: - **Kirchhoff's laws:** junction rule = **conservation of charge**; loop rule (sum of emfs and p.d.s = 0) = **conservation of energy**.

yadf3addd7a3.add: - **Prism dispersion:** **violet deviates most** (shortest wavelength, highest refractive index), **red least**.

y1efb774371e.add: - **Asexual reproduction:** budding (yeast, Hydra), fragmentation (Spirogyra), **gemmules** (sponges), spores; **syngamy** = gamete fusion (sexual).

yfd633b4697f.add: - **Paramecium** is a unicellular protozoan; Spirogyra (alga), Hydra and most fungi are multicellular.

yfa7f2f235b2.add: - **Plant tissues:** **collenchyma** – living, corners thickened with **cellulose, hemicellulose and pectin** (flexible support); **sclerenchyma** – **dead**, lignified walls; parenchyma – living, thin-walled.

y4a4e291f256.add: - **Isomers:** n-butane and isobutane (C4H10) = **chain isomers** (straight vs branched chain); position and functional isomers differ in group position / group.

yb56c96495b2.add: - **Energy for active transport** comes from **respiration** (ATP), not photosynthesis; movement down the gradient is diffusion.

yedb571b2551.add: - **Photosynthesis** = how green plants **make their own food**: CO2 + water + light → glucose (+ O2).

yaada1e19233.add: - **Chloroplast** = site of photosynthesis (chlorophyll in thylakoids); **mitochondrion** = site of aerobic respiration.

yeeb46c18dce.add: - **Grasshopper 'ears'** (tympanal organs) lie on the **first abdominal segment** – 'stomach' (abdomen) in exam options.

yc81f59ce63e.add: - **Meristems:** **apical** (root and shoot tips) – increase in **length**; **lateral** (cambium) – girth (secondary growth); intercalary – at internodes (grasses).

yb594ae57532.add: - **First law of thermodynamics** = **conservation of energy** applied to heat and work (ΔQ = ΔU + W); zeroth law – temperature/thermal equilibrium.

y69effc59c99.add: - **Second law (Clausius):** heat cannot flow by itself from a colder to a hotter body – a refrigerator needs external work.

yfd80b2b37f6.add: - **Waves** (sound) carry **energy, not matter** – particles only oscillate about their mean positions.

yf2193eb230b.add: - **Exothermic** (heat released): burning of fuels such as natural gas, **respiration**, **composting** of vegetable matter.

y0d561188d24.add: - **Pteridophytes** (ferns, Marsilea, horsetails, club mosses) = the first **vascular** plants, with no seeds; bryophytes have **no vascular tissue**.

yc5744bdb5cf.add: - **Earthing (grounding)** = transfer of charge from a charged object to the Earth.

yba1046bfede.add: - **Marsilea** = an aquatic **fern** (water clover), a pteridophyte with xylem and phloem.

yb0334267746.add: - **Fern allies** = horsetails (*Equisetum*), club mosses (*Lycopodium*), *Selaginella* – grouped with ferns in **Pteridophyta**.

yf321dd74440.add: - **Roots** are the main absorbing organ of plants (water and minerals).

y4c53eac414e.add: - **Flower colours:** red, pink, blue, purple = **anthocyanins** (in cell sap); yellow/orange = carotenoids.

y974bae94aee.add: - **Oldest organisms:** **blue-green algae (cyanobacteria)**, ~3.5 billion years (stromatolites); first life = prokaryotes.

y259e71e9232.add: - **Burning candle** = combustion – a **chemical, exothermic** change (wax melting alone is physical).

yf707071edf1.add: - **Transistor** = semiconductor amplifier/switch – found in **hearing aids**, radios; a fuse is a heating wire, a fluorescent lamp a gas-discharge tube.

yb72431dc742.add: - **Levels of organisation:** cellular aggregate – sponges (**Spongilla**, Sycon); tissue – coelenterates (**Obelia**); organ – flatworms (**Fasciola**); organ system – annelids (**Pheretima**) onward.

yb42bb9c27d4.add: - **Branches:** **cytology** – cells; histology – tissues; taxonomy – classification; physiology – functions.

y3c40c8c68ab.add: - **Oviparous** (lay eggs): frogs, most reptiles, birds; rabbit, mouse, squirrel are viviparous mammals.

y85442e4251d.add: - **Classification traps:** thallophytes have **no differentiated body**; **Funaria is a moss** (bryophyte); pteridophytes are cryptogams, not phanerogams.

y0457e12dd45.add: - **Cryptogams** = no seeds/flowers (thallophytes, bryophytes, pteridophytes); **phanerogams** = seed plants; pteridophytes = **vascular cryptogams**.

yd093d48977e.add: - **Stele:** the **protostele** (solid xylem core) is the most primitive, seen in early vascular plants (Rhynia); siphono-, dictyo- and atactostele are advanced.

y872a7c61c67.add: - **Invertebrates:** snail, octopus (molluscs), crab, prawn (arthropods), worms; vertebrates: fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, mammals.

yc8276076e81.add: - **Heart chambers:** fish **2** (Scoliodon); amphibians (frog, **salamander**) and most reptiles **3**; crocodile, birds, mammals **4**.

y48b003cebe2.add: - **Flower** = a **modified shoot**: the shoot apical meristem becomes a floral meristem; its parts are modified leaves.

y4f260481154.add: - **Gymnosperms** (pine, cycas) = **naked seeds** (no ovary, no fruit); angiosperms bear seeds inside fruits.

y638761a8681.add: - **Big cats:** *Panthera pardus* – **leopard**; *P. tigris* – tiger; *P. leo* – lion; 'panther' is a general name (black panther = melanistic leopard).

ybdae5fc9f3e.add: - **Cold-blooded** (poikilothermic): fish (**shark**), amphibians, reptiles; dolphins, whales and porpoises are warm-blooded mammals.

y639008cbfcb.add: - **Endothermic** = heat **absorbed** (e.g. CaCO3 → CaO + CO2 on heating, photosynthesis); exothermic = heat released.

y997316928c7.add: - **CO2:** **acidic oxide** (carbonic acid), turns **lime water milky** (CaCO3), **not poisonous** (asphyxiant only at high levels; CO is the poison).

y01e914d5753.add: - **X-ray tube:** only ~1% of the electrons' energy becomes X-rays; the rest is **heat at the target** (tungsten anode, cooled).

y5df98c7d59c.add: - **Firedamp = methane** – forms an explosive mixture with air in coal mines.

ye55c313a9bf.add: - **O2 is used directly only in the electron transport chain** (final electron acceptor); glycolysis and fermentation are anaerobic.

y63b27b54e3a.add: - **Periodic table:** across a period the **number of shells stays the same** (protons and electrons rise by 1); down a group shells increase.

ybf9aae44d64.add: - **Cut-off wavelength** λmin = hc/eV – **doubling the tube voltage halves** it.

ybba32a6dc2b.add: - **Pure substance vs mixture:** **ice** (solid water) is a compound; ice-cream, air, honey, milk are **mixtures**.

y759f99a7c23.add: - **Anomalous expansion:** water **contracts** from 0 °C to **4 °C** (max density), then expands; rail gaps and mercury thermometers use normal expansion.

yaef90d29291.add: - **Hypertonic medium** (more concentrated outside) – the cell **loses water** (plasmolysis); hypotonic – gains water.

y4d1bc591297.add: - **Mercury** = the only metal **liquid at room temperature** (bromine the only liquid non-metal; gallium, caesium melt near 30 °C).

ya0568cd6e0f.add: - Cadmium, germanium and tin are **solids** at room temperature; among metals only **mercury** is liquid.

ya1f67a2d8af.add: - **Sooty flame:** unsaturated/aromatic, carbon-rich compounds (benzene, naphthalene, anthracene) burn sooty; saturated alkanes (**hexane**) burn with a clean blue flame.

y677fcaa900b.add: - **Ripe banana:** main acid = **malic acid** (apples too); citric dominates in citrus.

y718bfc65ace.add: - **Calvin cycle:** CO2 + RuBP → **3-phosphoglyceric acid (PGA)**, the first stable product (C3 plants); glucose and starch come later.

y1448e8698c6.add: - **Glycolysis** (cytoplasm): glucose → **2 pyruvic acid**; ethanol + CO2 form only later in yeast fermentation.

yd8a3e300a4e.add: - **SO2** (S in +4) acts as both **reducing and oxidising agent**; H2, H2S, HI are reducing agents only.

ydd698b40efe.add: - **Litmus test logic:** red litmus stays red → **not a base** (could be acid or neutral); blue stays blue → not an acid.

y8942c7a7b7f.add: - **Lime water test:** CO2 + Ca(OH)2 → **CaCO3** (milky); CO, NH3 and NO2 do not do this.

y34e61be03ea.add: - **Nitric acid turns yellow** on standing: light decomposes it to brown **NO2**, which dissolves in it.

y479fab20b63.add: - **N fertilisers:** urea, ammonium sulphate, ammonium nitrate, ammonium phosphate, CAN – **ammonium sulphide** is not a fertiliser.

yd661bebf18c.add: - **Onion tears:** cutting releases **alliinase** – amino-acid sulfoxides → **sulfenic acid** → syn-propanethial-S-oxide (tear gas).

y1feeb7a1d4d.add: - **Sour milk:** bacteria make **lactic acid**, so pH falls **below 6** (fresh milk pH ~6.5).

y08791ba9cc2.add: - **Electron emission:** by light – **photoelectric** (Hertz 1887, Einstein); by heat – thermionic; by strong field – field emission.

y6fb24d98293.add: - **Parallel resistors:** net R is **less than the smallest** (2, 4, 8 Ω → 8/7 Ω); house wiring is parallel.

y2ce5621f851.add: - **Chlorophyll** has **magnesium (Mg)** at the centre of its porphyrin ring (haem has iron).

ye165f1dd895.add: - **Isoelectronic** = same number of electrons: **Na+, O2−**, F−, Mg2+, Al3+, Ne (10 e⁻); K+, Ca2+, Cl−, Ar (18 e⁻).

ybe19e19b857.add: - **2HgO → 2Hg + O2** on heating: mercuric oxide loses oxygen – **reduction** (Hg +2 → 0); burning Mg or S in O2 is oxidation.

y0f5aef7dd6f.add: - **Series resistors:** Rs = R1 + R2 + … – net resistance **increases**; the same current flows through all.

yef451c20b59.add: - **Solenoid:** field **inside is uniform** (parallel lines) – used to make electromagnets.

y3d7a74b692d.add: - **Accommodation:** ciliary muscles relax → lens **thinner → focal length increases** (distant vision); contract → thicker, shorter focal length (near).

y5865ae5400f.add: - **Hertz** = SI unit of **frequency** (1 cycle per second).

y2993c22ebd3.add: - **Metal feels colder** than plastic at the same temperature – metals are **good conductors of heat** and draw heat from the hand faster.

ycedbb0d9942.add: - **Bakelite** (phenol + formaldehyde, Baekeland 1907) = the **first fully synthetic plastic**, thermosetting, poor conductor of heat and electricity – switches, handles.

y26c091a4552.add: - **Lysosomes** = the '**suicidal bags**' – their enzymes can digest the cell itself when it is damaged.

y4dfa0c8bb93.add: - **Additive colours (light):** red + green + blue = **white**; green + blue = cyan, red + blue = magenta.

y8dc8f0ded30.add: - **Red + green light = yellow** (additive mixing); mixed paints behave differently (subtractive).

yce5a9083cf9.add: - **Primary colours of light** (photography, screens) = **red, green, blue**; yellow, cyan, magenta are secondary (printing inks).

ybda65580648.add: - **Double fertilisation** (sperm + egg → zygote; second sperm + polar nuclei → endosperm) is unique to **angiosperms**.

yff01c09e83b.add: - **Parthenocarpy** = fruit **without fertilisation** (seedless banana, grapes); parthenogenesis = embryo from unfertilised **egg**; apomixis = **seed** without fertilisation.

y89bd66c6539.add: - **Seedless fruits** (banana, grape) come from parthenocarpy – natural or induced by **auxins/gibberellins**.

yd92ad525a8d.add: - **Sexual reproduction in plants (order):** pollination → fertilisation → zygote divides → embryo → seed → seedling.

y95114b55aa1.add: - **Amoeba, Paramecium, Euglena** = **Protista** (unicellular eukaryotes); Monera holds prokaryotes only.

y54055b14b9b.add: - **Meristematic cells** are living, thin-walled and **actively dividing** – plant growth comes from their division (not dead, not only in bark).

y93f81d5002d.add: - **Dead plant tissues:** sclerenchyma (fibres, sclereids), xylem vessels and tracheids; epidermis, parenchyma and collenchyma are living.

y98e2c69cf1c.add: - **Hydrolytic enzymes** are packed in **lysosomes** (budded from the Golgi), which digest worn-out organelles.

y083799a1690.add: - **Esters** (e.g. **ethyl acetate**) have **fruity smells** – flavours and perfumes.

y9fe848113c6.add: - **Fungi:** eukaryotic, heterotrophic, unicellular (yeast) or multicellular; cell wall of **chitin**, not cellulose.

y8dd6477bcfb.add: - **Abscisic acid (ABA)** = the **stress hormone** – closes stomata, aids **drought tolerance**, seed dormancy.

y6882f8d3b72.add: - **Lysosome** = storehouse of **digestive enzymes**; ribosome – protein synthesis; desmosome – cell junction; vacuole – sap storage.

yafe0bebd62b.add: - **Monera** = bacteria (and cyanobacteria); mushrooms and yeast are fungi, moss a bryophyte.

y1ee0f130bc1.add: - **Seed dispersal agents:** wind, water, animals (and explosive fruits) – not fungi.

ya38949c2913.add: - **Copper in moist air** gets a green coat of **basic copper carbonate** [CuCO3·Cu(OH)2]; silver tarnishes black (Ag2S).

y2193b1f05fc.add: - **Root hairs** (zone of maturation) absorb the **most water**, not the growing point or zone of elongation.

y7bebc9cee97.add: - **DNA outside the nucleus:** only mitochondria and chloroplasts (not centrioles, Golgi or lysosomes).

y5dac5beb5c8.add: - Mitochondria have **70S ribosomes** and circular DNA, so they make **some of their own proteins**.

y65a07168b59.add: - **Evolution:** **natural selection** (Darwin) is the main mechanism; mutation supplies variation; acquired characters are not inherited.

y66d967e8e62.add: - **Ultrasonic waves** are produced by **piezoelectric** crystals (quartz) vibrating under AC voltage.

y9ccc89b3cad.add: - **Parallel wires:** currents in the **same direction attract**, opposite directions repel.

yfd62fc28580.add: - **C–C bond length:** single (ethane, **154 pm**) > benzene (139 pm) > double (ethene, 134 pm) > triple (ethyne, 120 pm).

ye24d5b60f45.add: - **Animals:** no cell wall, so **no cellulose**; heterotrophic, no chlorophyll, mostly mobile.

y384c3948095.add: - **Ohmic conductors** (V ∝ I) = metals such as **silver**, copper; semiconductors (Ge, Si) and carbon are non-ohmic.

y10efcfb8876.add: - **Conductivity = 1/resistivity**, so their product is **1 for every conductor**.

yb339d0093c7.add: - **House wiring** uses metals (copper, aluminium) because they are **good conductors** (free electrons).

y0e72aff6d0d.add: - **Mitochondria** = the '**powerhouses**' of the cell – aerobic respiration there makes ATP.

y55cbc6f9e48.add: - **Analogous organs:** different structure and origin, **same function** (bird and insect wings); homologous – same structure, different function.

yac573a2cdf3.add: - **Antipyretics** (paracetamol) bring down **fever**; antibiotics kill bacteria; antiseptics are used on living tissue.

y3f158c4c300.add: - **Whales** (mammals) breathe with **lungs** through a blowhole, not gills.

ye447b44e9bb.add: - **Metastasis** = spread of **cancer cells** via blood or lymph to other organs.

y57c5cabe451.add: - **Connective-tissue cells:** **adipocytes** – fat; chondrocytes – cartilage; osteocytes – bone; reticulocytes – young RBCs.

y94c3ee7bc5b.add: - **Plant drugs:** coca leaves – cocaine; *Claviceps* (ergot) – LSD; *Cannabis* – bhang, hashish; **peyote cactus – mescaline**; tea leaves – caffeine.

y134f8d86777.add: - **Cyanide** blocks **cytochrome c oxidase** of the electron transport chain – no ATP, so death within minutes.

y1adf2a5ad5c.add: - **Gizzard** grinds food in earthworms (red worms) and birds; crop stores it.

y80a57bef662.add: - **Metformin** = oral **anti-diabetic**; zolpidem – sleep aid, promethazine – antihistamine, hydralazine – blood pressure.

y32cdb0a6e1f.add: - **Multiplication rate:** bacteria (~20 min), viruses, fungi multiply fast; **worms** reproduce **slowly**.

y1b549ff3bc9.add: - **Mammals:** hair, **four-chambered heart**, mammary glands; monotremes (platypus) lay eggs; whales and dolphins are aquatic.

yef9a5df32cf.add: - **Fundamental (SI base) quantities:** length, **mass**, time, current, temperature, amount, luminous intensity; **weight** is a force (derived); mass = amount of matter, same everywhere.

yc507ad0a617.add: - **Diatomic:** H2, N2, O2, halogens (**I2**); **monoatomic:** noble gases (He) and metals (Cu, Ba).

y8615bb4fc9c.add: - **Drug sources:** poppy – **morphine**; bacteria (*Streptomyces*) – **tetracycline**; cinchona bark – **quinine**; *Penicillium* fungus – **penicillin**.

yb23da78d641.add: - **Angstrom (Å)** = 10⁻¹⁰ m – a unit of **length**, used for wavelengths and atomic sizes.

y983ca1a8cd2.add: - **Pleiotropy** = one gene controls **several characters**; polygenic = many genes, one trait.

ya1d43cf12fe.add: - **Dicot seeds:** **pulses**, gram, pea, bean (2 cotyledons); monocots: rice, wheat, maize.

y3f1f030b128.add: - **Vegetative propagation** gives **clones**, can be done most of the year, but **passes viruses on** (only meristem culture frees plants of virus).

yc77bf9bbbfa.add: - **O2 is the by-product** of photosynthesis (from splitting water); sugar is the product, CO2 a raw material.

y4cd68a8562f.add: - **Tungsten** = hardest metal among common options (highest melting point; chromium is hardest pure metal by Mohs).

y975c271df60.add: - **Human ancestors (old → recent):** Java man, Peking man (*H. erectus*), Neanderthal, **Cro-Magnon** (early modern *H. sapiens*, latest).

yda889197636.add: - **Cellulose** gives **no colour with iodine**; starch blue-black – both are plant glucose polymers.

y5329bc150c4.add: - **Zoology** studies animals, **living and dead** (fossils); botany studies plants.

yd753ebce929.add: - **Evolutionary order:** fish → amphibians (salamander) → reptiles (python) → mammals (kangaroo) / birds.

y10d860394c5.add: - **Ice cools a drink** by taking **latent heat of fusion** (336 J/g) from it while melting.

y9878bd18fb5.add: - **Heating coil:** H = I²Rt = V²t/R – depends on **voltage, current and time**.

y3016db32a6b.add: - **Pressure** = force/area; SI unit **N/m² = pascal**; N·m = joule (work).
